items.title: What was the Industrial Revolution?
items.response: The Industrial Revolution was a period of history when people invented machines and factories changed how things were made. It began in the late 1700s and changed society forever.

items.title: What was the Renaissance?
items.response: The Renaissance was a period of renewed interest in art, science, and learning. It began in Italy around the 1300s and marked the end of the Middle Ages and the beginning of modern Europe.
